attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Montana state income tax per Form 2. Montana uses progressive tax brackets: 4.7% on first bracket, 5.9% above threshold. Thresholds vary by filing status: Single/MFS $21,100, MFJ $42,200, HOH $31,700. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($4,500 Single, $11,500 MFJ), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_postfix: "MONTANA FORM 2 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.mt_agi xdef 0 /result.mt_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.mt_bracket_2_tax xdef

action_details.action_description: Calculate MT tax with MFJ standard deduction and progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.mt_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto mt_standard_deduction_mfj /result.mt_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.mt_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.mt_agi result.mt_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.mt_taxable_income xdef " MT Taxable Income: $" result.mt_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.mt_taxable_income mt_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f> if mt_bracket_2_threshold_mfj mt_bracket_1_rate f* /result.mt_bracket_1_tax xdef result.mt_taxable_income mt_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- mt_bracket_2_rate f* /result.mt_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (4.7% on $0-$42,200): $" result.mt_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (5.9% above $42,200): $" result.mt_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.mt_taxable_income mt_bracket_1_rate f* /result.mt_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (4.7% on $0-$" result.mt_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.mt_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif result.mt_bracket_1_tax result.mt_bracket_2_tax f+ /result.mt_tax xdef " Total MT Tax: $" result.mt_tax cvs strconcat " (Montana Form 2)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
